config.head: mlp_691200
config.claim_scope: Two predetermined validation trajectories per boundary; development pilot only, no final-cohort confirmation.
config.input_output_contract: One host-resident displacement and velocity field, scalar physical wave speed; return displacement and physical velocity on the requested mesh at all 49 observation times, on host. Homogeneous unforced equation.
config.force_scale: initial displacement mass-L2 norm / horizon squared
config.affine_forcing: Retained exactly, including nonzero offset. Supplied speed enters timed setup and propagation.
config.full_field_audit: All full-grid same-grid references and learned bank tables plus every first-repetition ROM coefficient state saved; common-grid outputs retained for every method. Repetition hashes retained.
config.status: approved bounded implementation; not yet submitted
config.weak_overdetermination_note: 64 fixed weak bank equations for 32 new latent coordinates; ratio 2, still strictly overdetermined. This differs from the incumbent ratio 4; no new weak test space or bank is introduced.
config.training_objective: Original coefficient reconstruction / per-case initial-displacement scale squared, plus original mean code-squared penalty. No velocity/tangent/force/rollout loss.
config.ordering: Alternate complete method order by repetition; burn before every timed invocation.
fit_starts: six equally spaced rows of the endpoint training-code library
diagnostics: weak normal force with fixed initial physical scale
config.cost_control: Frozen MLP16 retains primary dt .0025 with three repetitions. Each new MLP32 uses dt .01,.005,.0025 with three repetitions. One separately labeled fine .00125 query per endpoint/case supplies accuracy refinement only; its complete-query timing is preserved but is ineligible for speed selection and may include uncached compilation. Test adjacent step pairs .01/.005, .005/.0025, .0025/.00125.
config.query_contract: Full host u0,v0 and scalar speed to 49 dense host u,v outputs at 0:.05:2.4. All full input projection/fitting, speed preparation, evolution, decoding and transfer charged.

runtime_budget_estimate.basis: Measured dynamics02 timings, with a conservative factor 4 for K32 nonlinear evolution and explicit allowance for regeneration, training, compilation, diagnosis andsaving.

config.training_regeneration: Regenerate original seed/count at original training mesh/CFL on cluster; stream coefficients/scales and original field hashes. Prior saved coefficients are audit lineage only; do not upload them as training data.
config.acceptance: Finite/frozen-bank/provenance gates required. Preserve all nonstationary fits, rank failures, failed rollouts and underresolved time steps explicitly; no relaxed acceptance or additional training by validation selection. No final cohort opened.
config.claims: Development K32 representation/evolution/time-step comparisons only. Same-grid FOM ratios are not an efficient coarse-FOM envelope. Absorber current-relative errors and vanishing flags remain required beside fixed-scale errors.

data_regeneration.construction: Unnormalized training displacement coefficients, centered SVD and population-standard-deviation scaling, original convention.
Unnormalized training displacement coefficients, centered SVD and population-standard-deviation scaling, original convention.
